text:
140 PRs merged this week. The Responses API is now a proper route; community models grew roots across embeddings, images, video, speech, and audio; agents got tools, harnesses, and MCP connections; and the catalog got clearer while the plumbing got less interested in surprising anyone. Also: more models, more fallbacks, fewer mysterious stream-shaped objects. 🌱🐝

Everything is in the open: github.com/pollinations
